conditions: Three frozen story cases, two seeds per case, 230–236 whitespace-separated prompt words, exactly one reference per image. Multi-reference, editing, inpainting and batch inference are not measured by this workload.
One paid GPU at a time. Independent ComfyUI processes share that GPU; request queues alone are not concurrency.

Six frozen cases/seeds repeat. Cached profiles allow warm conditioning; productionProfiles separately force and verify fresh text and reference VAE encoding. Sampler and VAE decode must execute freshly in both.
Cohort wall time includes retrieval, PNG encoding, durable saving and receipts. Warm worker/model setup is excluded from throughput, included in experiment cost.
Operation overlap proves simultaneous server tasks; it does not prove simultaneous CUDA kernels or 100% GPU utilization.
Two rounds are small samples on one host/region. Observed range is not a statistical confidence interval.
Different rental attempts are not pooled. Scaling curves use only one latest rental host at a time; missing worker counts are not filled from old hosts. Receipts retain previous attempts.
PNG repeatability tests determinism, not story quality. Different seeds/prompts, novel encoding and long-run contention require production validation.
Every PNG is compressed and checked; byte-identical PNGs may reuse a durable local blob. The storage reuse fraction is reported; novel chapter outputs may add physical disk writing cost.
Hybrid profiles use two bounded clients per previously admitted resident model copy. Every client has isolated provider state; server-copy count and request-slot count remain separate.

Per-image and rental accounting exposes unassigned time. Backend execution is nested within waiting, not charged as an extra client stage. Experimental warmups and utility calls are excluded from warm throughput but included in test cost.

Pipeline profiles overlap client requests through one serial ComfyUI process. Client slots are not resident model copies; cloud execution overlap must remain one. Neither method changes model weights or inference settings.
Mississauga client connection measurements, when available, use idle TCP establishment and tunneled application requests. These are not pure ping. Location alone is not a reason to reject a GPU.
Startup/download times vary by host. Repeated process/config warmups are experiment overhead and must not all be charged as normal production startup.
Older 1344x768 serial evidence remains separate. 1080p local rendering is uncalibrated; no complete video-time guarantee.
Catalog-only GPUs remain visible without invented timing. Stock is an observation, not a causal performance correction. Requested region and provider-confirmed region are distinguished.

costLedger.basis: Conservative rental ceilings plus standing storage. Includes experimental overhead; not an exact invoice. An unresolved allocation remains charged conservatively until reconciled.
